metadata.question: Was there more snow water equivalent in a 30 mile radius around Kabul, Afghanistan in February 2018 in comparison to February 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Kabul, Afghanistan (approximately 34.52°N, 69.18°E). Define a 30-mile radius polygon around this point. - Dates: February 2017 and February 2018. - Collection: MODIS Snow Water Equivalent (SWE) data, e.g., `MODIS/061/MOD10A1` or similar snow products. Alternatively, use `GLDAS` which includes SWE estimates. - Fallback: If MOD10A1 is unavailable, try GLDAS snow water equivalent. 2. Masking strategy: - Snow Water Equivalent is a direct measurement, not affected by clouds in the same way as reflectance data. However, cloud cover can affect SWE retrieval. - Filter for valid pixels (non-null SWE values). No additional cloud masking needed unless the data has a quality flag. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs. Null: - Valid Zero: SWE = 0 (no snow) is legitimate. This should result in Answer A or B. - Null/Invalid: SWE is None, NaN, or pixel count is 0 after filtering → C3 or C2. - Compare mean or total SWE for Feb 2017 vs. Feb 2018. If Feb 2018 > Feb 2017 → A (Yes); else → B (No). ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Kabul location and 30-mile radius (~48.28 km) const kabulCoords = [69.18, 34.52]; // [lon, lat] const radiusKm = 48.28; // 30 miles const kabulPoint = ee.Geometry.Point(kabulCoords); const kabulBuffer = kabulPoint.buffer(radiusKm * 1000); // Convert to meters // 2. Fetch MODIS Snow Water Equivalent data const feb2017 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD10A1') .filterDate('2017-02-01', '2017-02-28') .filterBounds(kabulBuffer) .select('SWE'); const feb2018 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD10A1') .filterDate('2018-02-01', '2018-02-28') .filterBounds(kabulBuffer) .select('SWE'); // 3. Check collection sizes const size2017 = feb2017.size().getInfo(); const size2018 = feb2018.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Feb 2017 Images: ${size2017}`); console.log(`Feb 2018 Images: ${size2018}`); if (size2017 === 0 || size2018 === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Merge and compute mean SWE for each month const mean2017 = feb2017.mean(); const mean2018 = feb2018.mean(); // 5. Calculate mean SWE values within the buffer region const stats2017 = mean2017.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: kabulBuffer, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2018 = mean2018.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: kabulBuffer, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }); // 6. Extract SWE values const swe2017 = stats2017.get('SWE').getInfo(); const swe2018 = stats2018.get('SWE').getInfo(); console.log(`Feb 2017 Mean SWE: ${swe2017}`); console.log(`Feb 2018 Mean SWE: ${swe2018}`); // 7. Validate results if (swe2017 === null || swe2018 === null || isNaN(swe2017) || isNaN(swe2018)) { console.log('C3'); return; } // 8. Pixel count check const count2017 = mean2017.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: kabulBuffer, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('SWE').getInfo(); const count2018 = mean2018.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: kabulBuffer, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('SWE').getInfo(); console.log(`Feb 2017 Valid Pixels: ${count2017}`); console.log(`Feb 2018 Valid Pixels: ${count2018}`); if (count2017 === 0 || count2018 === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } // 9. Compare and output answer console.log(`Comparison: 2017=${swe2017.toFixed(2)} mm, 2018=${swe2018.toFixed(2)} mm`); if (swe2018 > swe2017) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
